summary: Implemented the Databricks OAuth profile mapping. Changes: new cosmos/profiles/databricks/oauth.py with DatabricksOauthProfileMapping (required fields host, schema, client_secret, client_id, http_path; secret fields client_id and client_secret; airflow mapping host/schema/extra.http_path/client_id from login then extra.client_id/client_secret from password then extra.client_secret; profile merges mapped params, profile args, auth_type oauth, and env-var refs for both secrets). Databricks package __init__.py exports it. profiles/__init__.py imports it, places it directly after DatabricksTokenProfileMapping in profile_mappings, and adds it to __all__. New tests/profiles/databricks/test_dbr_oauth.py covers claiming, token-over-OAuth selection, OAuth selection, profile output, overrides, and env vars. Tests were NOT run, per instructions. Nothing committed. Note: cosmos/profiles/__init__.py changed on disk mid-session; its current contents match the intended edit.
